title: Bug 648959: [Subcontracting] Fix serial splitting for non-last subcontracting put-away lines
summary: Subcontracting inventory put-away lines with serial tracking are no longer incorrectly split into quantity-1 lines when not marked as last operation.
key_points: Serial tracking fallback logic is intercepted for non-physical NotLastOperation lines
Full remaining quantity is inserted through the standard inventory put-away path for NotLastOperation
Regression test added to verify line cardinality, zero base quantities, blank tracking, and absence of physical ledger entries
